data.summary:
7+ years of experience in Capital Markets, specializing in Regulatory Reporting, Risk Data Governance, and Trade Lifecycle management. Expertise in Counterparty & Credit Risk with strong exposure to EMIR, MiFID, and Dodd-Frank, Basel, BCBS-239 regulations. Skilled in Business Analysis and QA Testing, including requirement gathering, impact analysis, UAT/regression testing, and data validation across upstream and downstream systems. Proven ability to improve data quality, ensure regulatory compliance, and support end-to-end clearing and settlement processes in high-volume environments.
Skill Summary:
Regulatory Expertise: Basel, BCBS 239, MIFID, EMIR, Dodd Frank, EMIR REFIT, SFTR, European Market Infrastructure Regulation, IFRS9.
Risk Reporting: Market Data Management, Data Quality, Disclosure, COREP Reports, Reconciliation & C.R Analysis, Reference Data Management, European Market Regulatory.
Technical: Power BI, SQL, Advance Excel, Microsoft Product for Data Analysis, Python, JIRA / ADO, FIXML,
Confluence, Jenkins.

Work Experience
3. Senior Lead Analyst | Accenture |Client: Deutsche Borse | Oct 2025 – Present |
Strong documentation skills – BRD, FRD, User stories Workflows and analytical and problem-solving skills, consultation with business development, application development, other stake holders and market participants. Update test cases, test execution, analysis, & testing.
Analyzing current processes to identify gaps and improvement opportunities and conducting impact assessments across upstream and downstream systems to detect issues. Issue investigation, root cause analyses.
Process of inspecting, cleansing, transforming & modelling data with the goal of discovering useful meaningful
information, suggesting conclusions from which the emergent knowledge is applied to stakeholders/ clients’ problems to support decision-making. Understand & interpreting insights where applied statistics, pattern, analysis, predictive analytics have been used.

Functional support of the implementation, especially with management & analysis of functional issues, prepare test reports & documentation. Large scale data processing, Data warehouse & monitoring ETL pipelines.
Responsible for creating and running tests like UAT, Regression and Level Testing, Stress testing by test planning and execution identifying errors and providing feedback to ensure a final product meets a company's quality standards.
Performing scenario & sensitivity analysis to evaluate resistance of portfolios, counterparty credit risk exposures & capital adequacy.
Develop and execute manual and automated tests for new & existing products & document tests results and provide feedback to respective teams & stakeholders, ensure issues are fixed before release.
Worked in Dodd Frank regulator initiatives involving testing, regulatory change implementation, functional validation, reconciliation & impact analysis across risk & reporting systems.
Good Understanding of Trade life cycle, Equity, Bond’s, Swaps, Repo, SFT’s & Derivatives & Financial \ Capital market products. Role in Pre & Post Trade process, Clearing & Settlements, Core functions of risk management Margining, netting, Trade validation etc. Develop solutions for CCP System.
Understanding system flows & architecture for the identification of issues and RCA & resolutions and implementing better changes, develop & execute test plans, test cases, test scripts.
Performing compliance monitoring controls & spot checks on MIFID, EMIR, Dodd Frank, EMIR REFIT, SFTR Regulations, Support and maintenance of Clearing Systems for securities clearing for all cleared assets. (IRS, FX, FO, FRA)

Issue investigation, root cause analyses, identifying dependencies on other areas or business and mitigate risks by bringing resolution during implementation and production phases.
2. Team Lead Business Analyst – | Standard Chartered Bank | December 12, 2022 – October 12,2025 |
Basel Regulatory, Risk Management & Business Conduct
Understanding & articulating banking products & country specific regulatory requirements including but not limited to PRA, BASEL, IFRS9 framework, matrix computation methodologies and regulatory parameters.
Exposure on Counterparty & Credit Risk Concepts such as SACCR, Standardized, Regulatory Capital Models compliant with Basel III/IV, IRB, Internal Modeling Methods (IMM).
Credit Risk Models development and validation for LGD, PD, EAD in alignment with Basel
Regulatory Standards, ensuring model performance through statistical analysis and back-testing.
Good understanding of banking products and co-relate to Market Data (Interest Rate, Foreign Exchange, Commodity), Risk Factors set up and analysis of Currency / pairs rates, Historic Data, Time Series Analysis, PFE, SFT’s, Derivatives (ETD, OTC), Mark to Market, MPOR, Regulatory Reporting as in MIFID, EMIR, Dodd Frank, EMIR REFIT, SFTR, Basel for RWA, EAD, CAR, CCB, CCYB, PD, LGD.
Prepare process documents such as using case specifications based on scope of work and business defined by product owner & turn them into well-formed formal business requirements (BRD & FSD) or uses stories.
Design and implement models for Stress Testing and Scenario Analysis to analyze how banks and
investment portfolios fare in drastic economic scenarios market value of the counterparty credit risk and potential losses stemming from market variable fluctuations. to strengthen the reliability and repeatability of key processes used in capital stress testing and adequacy framework.
Testing Calculations such as stress testing, UAT, Level / Control testing & Regression testing
methodologies and movement in regulatory reporting and adapt to changes to quickly align with new process / operating models.
Use of SQL to interrogate and extract data for the analysis and understanding of Moody’s reporting platforms.
Review of test cases and test evidence on defined requirements and verify the solution meets the expectations of the business requirements by walkthrough of UVT results to stakeholders and obtaining UAT signoff from respective business stakeholders.
Pre-Deployment verification – Ensure all the controls are met prior to development OR explicitly approved by PO
Post-Deployment verification – Ensure development is successfully completed in the production environment.
Use of JIRA / ADO to create uses stories & follow through priorities for bus and stories into development
stage based on requirement.
Support team to review & document the strategic requirements, work closely with internal & external stakeholders and collaboration partners to deliver the required.

Individual and team contributors extensively worked with people in business as well as technical teams and were comfortable in communication with cross functional teams.
BCBC 239, Risk Data Governance, Compliance & Linage
Ensuring compliance with BCBS 239 principles for effective risk data aggregation and reporting.
Ensuring solution complies with laid down process steps, bank’s Data Quality and Reporting Standards.
Monitor & ensure that appropriate Change governance is followed across all transformation initiatives.
Represent the function at the governance forums in place for tracking change initiatives and influence decisions in respect of the change backlog, prioritization, choice of technology tools & the operating model.
Effectively & collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate & resolve risk, conduct & compliance matters.
Provide data assurance through reconciliation and data profiling, Lineage on critical data elements that impact CCR Risk Measures and Risk Reporting.
Detect data issues against source / data / destination & investigate and follow up with stake holders until resolution.
 Track data quality issues against agreed KCI Threshold and ensure the same is followed & investigate
and respond to queries pertaining to CCR Data.
 Maintenance of Market reference data and update of data in CCRM Risk Systems to improve completeness and accuracy of risk data such as Market Data, Trade Data, Agreement & Collateral Data, Credit Limits, Counterparty Static, Counterparty Hierarchy, Market Data – IR, FX, CO spot + Historic, Vols, Time Series Analysis for CCY / CCY pair, Market data & Reference data management, Climate risk.
Perform DQ controls in accordance to relevant BCBS 239 Principles & establish robust governance and controls for the reporting process including the requirements to manage report quality and operational control.
Act as the point of contact for clients, stakeholders and internal teams, providing guidance, addressing inquiries, and resolving issues promptly and effectively.
Work closely with Front Office Teams CCIB, CCR Modeling & other teams resolving the queries, issues and managing the risk.
Work with audit teams to ensure all processes are compliant & efficient.
Performed in depth data analysis to identify data issues and escalate, mitigate and resolve strategic data solutions.
Familiarity with Asset Control, TP Systems (Murex, Razor, Sabre, Single Customer Identifier / SCI-H, Bloomberg), Horizon, Harrier simulation engine, Adaptec Analytics engine.
1. Team Lead -
| Wipro | [September 9,2019 - September 10,2022]
Building & maintaining regulatory data linage framework to ensure traceability, transparency and audit readiness.
Supported data governance frameworks by defining and maintaining critical data elements, mapping data lineage, and identifying data gaps, performing data quality validations, data gap analysis & establishing conform for CRDE’s.
Performed data analysis and quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency of risk and capital data submissions.
Monthly & Daily Reconciliation of money settlement of balances, Cash Claims and other transactions.
Reconciling & Investigation of daily / monthly reports on money settlement of balances, Cash Claims and other transactions to ensure validity and accuracy of financial information.
Doing Root Cause Analysis (R C A) in case of errors, quality/ metrics issues impacting the client.
Using data visualization tools to provide a comprehensive interface to end users to quickly identify key themes within their data by creating interactive dashboards and reports using Excel, Tableau / Power BI to visualize data issues, lineage coverage, and control checks for efficient data management.
Worked extensively on BCBS 239 implementation for Counterparty and Credit Risk, focusing on data quality, data governance, and lineage.
Internal
